description: Source code implementing a text box dialog component for a Linux kernel configuration interface, including functions for displaying, scrolling, and rendering text within a windowed UI.

methods.name: dialog_textbox
methods.description: Displays a text box dialog with scrollable text content, handling user input for navigation and exit.

methods.name: back_lines
methods.description: Moves the current text pointer back by n lines in the buffer.

methods.name: get_line
methods.description: Retrieves the current line of text from the buffer.

methods.name: print_line
methods.description: Renders a single line of text in the window, supporting horizontal scrolling.

methods.name: print_page
methods.description: Renders a page of text lines in the window.

methods.name: print_position
methods.description: Displays the current scroll position as a percentage.

methods.name: refresh_text_box
methods.description: Refreshes the window content with current text and position.
